units.warning: LDraw coordinates are reference CAD/assembly geometry. They do not establish mould tolerances, interference fits, friction, or production clearances.

sources.name: Minifig Torso with Arms and Yellow Hands
observations: 973.dat torso is placed at the assembly origin with the identity transform.
3818.dat right arm is placed at [-15.552, 9, 0] LDU with the torso-slope alignment transform.
3819.dat left arm is placed at [15.552, 9, 0] LDU with the mirrored torso-slope alignment transform.
3820.dat hands are included with explicit posed assembly transforms; those hand transforms are useful pose references but are not wrist-socket metrology.

sources.name: Minifig Arm Right
help_metadata: Rotate about x for arm elevation, then 9.782 degrees about z to align with torso slope.

sources.name: Minifig Arm Left
help_metadata: Rotate about x for arm elevation, then -9.782 degrees about z to align with torso slope.

sources.name: Minifig Hips and Legs (Standing)
observations: 3815b.dat hips are placed at the assembly origin.
3816c.dat and 3817c.dat legs are each placed at [0, 12, 0] LDU relative to the hips shortcut origin.
BrickLink cross-reference in the LDraw header is 970c00.
